overview_description.description: Diode Computers designs and manufactures custom circuit boards with a focus on integrating artificial intelligence into the development process. The company provides services from the initial design phase through to volume production. It utilizes a toolchain that includes open-source software like the PCB Compiler and Spec Generator, enabling rapid circuit board design and compatibility with traditional EDA tools such as KiCad and Altium. Diode Computers also offers real-time feedback on component costs and availability, helping businesses optimize their designs. The AI-driven process reduces development time for applications in industries such as robotics, aerospace, and edge computing.

about_short_description.short_description: Diode Computers designs and manufactures custom circuit boards on integrating artificial intelligence into the development process.

product.name: PCB Compiler
product.description: An open source toolchain that compiles circuit schematics from code in milliseconds, built in Rust.

product.name: Spec Generator
product.description: A tool that converts user requirements into manufacturable circuit board designs within hours using AI models.

product.name: EDA Native Export
product.description: Capability to export AI-generated designs to standard EDA tools like KiCad, Altium, and Cadence for further processing.

product.name: Human-in-the-Loop Verification
product.description: A process where experienced electrical engineers review AI-generated designs to ensure safety, compliance, and manufacturability before production.

product.name: BOM Compiler
product.description: A tool that matches each component in a design to distributor and manufacturer items, providing real-time cost and availability data.

product.name: Instant Quote
product.description: A service that delivers real-time feedback on manufacturing assembly and component costs for custom circuit board designs.
